help_result.output:
usage: main.py [-h] {doctor,run,resume,translate} ...

GPUv1-A05 source-native adapter for the fairseq s2t_transformer_s CoVoST2 en-
de recipe. Never fabricates data, weights or predictions.

positional arguments:
  {doctor,run,resume,translate}
    doctor              Inspect required inputs/deps (no training).
    run                 Train and export (CUDA required).
    resume              Resume from checkpoint_last.pt.
    translate           Decode a new frozen English TSV.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
